title: Geologic map of the Moncks Corner quadrangle, Berkeley County, South Carolina
citation: Weems, R.E., and Lemon, E.M., 1987, Geologic map of the Moncks Corner quadrangle, Berkeley County, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQ-1641, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Page 3 is OCR of the full map sheet; text is mostly clean. Pages 1-2 are the cover and a standard symbol sheet. Most map-unit symbols in the legend boxes were lost in OCR; symbols are taken from the text where they name a unit (flagged inferred). The Ladson clayey facies symbol and the barrier facies symbols for the Wando/Ten Mile Hill were not legible. Auger-hole log columns (MC 30, MC 2, MC 11, MC 25, MC 27 ...) are not legible enough to record intervals or to match surface elevations to holes. The Dutton (1889) reference is garbled and was skipped. Estuarine deposits age differs from the Ladson sheet (4,000-7,000 years here).
